scope: Windows bounded span provider only; no real model working set or GPU supply
capacity_policy: Constructor config must fit actual aligned buffer capacities; arbitrary span lists stream by cursor. Pipeline capacities are not model/context/output/cache limits.
logical_base_policy: physical offset = logical absolute offset - FixtureView source base; physical file size must equal view bytes
control: WAKE_TAG UINT64_MAX is reserved; no data tag collision/wrap, no credit recovery from control/unknown/duplicate
lifetime: Caller retains immutable Identity/span descriptors/destination/aligned buffers/provider/DirectFile until all completions collected. Failed drain quarantines and prohibits reuse; never close with outstanding writes.
fallback: Safe drained direct failure may use buffered/mmap on guarded same source. Genuine bounds/short/identity failure is never rescued. Unknown measurement alone never disables fallback.
OS_global_cache: unknown; bounded own buffers/mapped windows do not imply bounded OS file cache
EOF_observation: Actual past-EOF data completion required; Windows may choose asynchronous IOCP without immediate nudge. Explicit real wake and shared-adapter control mixing verify control credits; observed internal nudge count may be zero.
owner_connection: Actual T16 host Reading to Filled callback and cancelled Reading drain; synthetic unused Device descriptor, no GPU/event claim.
metadata_scope: Wrapper object/vector/path capacity payload only; allocator overhead, DirectFile private heap and OS cache unknown. Buffered read_exact temporary <= max_chunk; mapping range includes allocation-granularity prefix.
